workflowSteps.label: Assign to person/entity

workflowSteps.label: Assign compliance status

workflowSteps.label: Update driver readiness
workflowSteps.description: Update driver, carrier, load, settlement, or readiness status after review.

standardRules.description: POD, BOL, rate confirmation, carrier packet, insurance COI, W-9, and driver qualification evidence are checked before readiness, billing, or settlement status changes.
Missing, expired, low-confidence, or mismatched documents route to the correct BOF review queue before they update an operating status.
Billing, settlement, factoring, reimbursement, and deduction statuses remain visible separately so one issue does not hide the next action.

aggregatorRules.description: Carrier, driver, document packet, billing, and settlement exceptions roll up into the Midwest Carrier Network readiness view.
Commercial holds are separated from driver readiness so the network can see when a driver remains usable but a payment, billing, or accessorial item still needs review.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: Aggregator submits batch
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Midwest Carrier Network submits 842 documents for 100 drivers.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: BOF receives the package as an unstructured operating queue.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF classifies hierarchy
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: BOF maps documents to carriers, operating units, drivers, and document packets.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: The network becomes searchable by aggregator, carrier, operating unit, driver, and packet.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF converts files
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Messy file names become BOF Vault canonical records.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: The same record can support readiness, billing, settlement, and review.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF applies default rules
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Standard document, readiness, billing, and settlement rules are applied.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: BOF keeps one internal operating model before carrier-specific rules modify outcomes.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF applies carrier agreement rules
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Each carrier's contract terms modify settlement, billing, accessorial, and document requirements.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: Different carrier agreements can produce different commercial outcomes from similar document issues.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF routes exceptions
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Missing PODs, expired documents, wrong-driver matches, missing temperature records, and missing approvals go to review.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: The right desk sees the next action instead of searching through a shared folder.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF updates readiness
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Driver, carrier, operating unit, and aggregator readiness summaries update.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: The network sees readiness by level instead of guessing from isolated documents.

aggregatorAnimationSteps.label: BOF shows commercial impact
aggregatorAnimationSteps.description: Billing held, settlement held, factoring incomplete, reimbursement held, or readiness unaffected depending on the carrier agreement.
aggregatorAnimationSteps.impact: Operators see payment, billing, settlement, and readiness consequences separately.
